params.name: status
params.description:
Filter returned knowledge domains to those that match this Status. The REST query parameter is "status" and the value can be a string or integer representation. The only way to see DECOMMISSIONED KD's is to specify that status value here - please be aware that those KD's can and will disappear so do not expect them to be there on subsequent requests.

 - CONTENT_AWAIT: CONTENT_AWAIT: Initial value for a newly created KD.  If KD was created with data.uri or data.contents then asynchronous status transition will occur to CONTENT_IDENTIFIED after constituent Content Group and Contents are created.  If KD was created without either of these then it will remain in this status until an explicit PATCH with CONTENT_IDENTIFIED status is received.
 - CONTENT_IDENTIFIED: CONTENT_IDENTIFIED: When a KD enters this state, our automation will begin the process of readying the content for Conversation Exchanges by ingesting each constituent Content.
 - CONTENT_READY: CONTENT_READY: The KD's content is ready and able to support conversation exchanges.  Each Content in the KD's Content Groups has been successfully ingested.
 - CONTENT_NOT_SUPPORTED: CONTENT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Unable to support conversation exchanges on this KD's content due to some problem readying its Contents.  You can look for constituent Contents that have INGESTION_FAILED status to find out more details.  To retry, update KD status to CONTENT_IDENTIFIED using PATCH.  If the problem persists then remove the INGESTION_FAILED contents from the KD's Content Group(s) and try again.
 - DECOMMISSIONED: DECOMMISSIONED: KD is no longer needed, is not going to be used for conversation exchanges, and should be removed from the system.  The KD is going to be removed from the system ASAP by ongoing housekeeping operations.  Any KD can transition to DECOMMISSIONED status.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter list outputs to only include users that match this status. Defaults to UNSPECIFIED which disables this filter.
The REST query parameter is "status" and value can be the string or integer representation.

 - UNSPECIFIED: UNSPECIFIED: Default value that will never be used by the API as it is indistinguishable from unspecified status.
 - PENDING: PENDING: Waiting to be enabled by an organization admin.
Useful to organization admins in gradually rolling out Pryon Platform access to organization users (e.g. bulk adding users and then enabling them in batches).
 - DISABLED_BY_ADMIN: DISABLED_BY_ADMIN: Administratively disabled by the organization admin (e.g. due to compromised credentials).
 - DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_OPERATOR: DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_OPERATOR: Disabled by a Pryon Service Operator (e.g. due to abuse).
Only a Pryon Service Operator can transition a user into and out of this state.
 - ACTIVE: ACTIVE: The user is in a functionally operational state

params.name: type
params.description:
Filter list outputs to only include users of this type. Defaults to UNSPECIFIED which disables this filter.
The REST query parameter is "type" and value can be the string or integer representation.

 - UNSPECIFIED: UNSPECIFIED: Default value not used to characterize users internally.
 - HUMAN: HUMAN: A human user identified by a valid email address.
 - MACHINE: MACHINE: A machine user operating without human interaction and identified by its client id.

Create a new test question associate with an existing collection. The question will be included in future regression test runs.
The number of test questions for a given collection is limited to a maximum capacity. The operation will fail if capacity is met.

params.name: base_collection_id
params.description: Required. The parent collection the tests are associated with. The REST query parameter is base_collection_id.

items.docs: List tests associated with a given collection.
Create a test comparing two existing knowledge domains, aka collection versions. A single test may be created for a collection draft-domain pair.
Retrieve a test by id.
Delete a test and all its associated test results

params.name: test_id
params.description: Required.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items to be returned. Valid values are 1-100. Default is 100. The REST query parameter is "page_size".

params.name: page_token
params.description:
If there are multiple pages, pages 2-N must specify this parameter using the value of next_page_token provided in the previous page's response. The REST query parameter is "page_token".
see https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/design_patterns#list_pagination.

items.docs: Retrieves the result set associated with this test from storage. The output will only include test results already executed prior to list time.

Retrieves the test result corresponding to a given question id from storage. The question entity must already have been declared within the scope of the test collection. If the test result does not already exist on the server, such as on a first retrieval operation, it will be generated on the fly.
Synthesizes speech synchronously according to the text input and settings.
